svg.aria-label: Complete wiring diagram centred on the ESP32-S3-ETH-8DI-8RO module drawn as photographed. The DrainMaster push-button 12 volt feed is spliced through five-port WAGOs P1 and G1, which power the board, the DI common, and the plus-12 and ground buses. Relay channels CH8 through CH1 run left to right; odd channels take NO to the plus-12 bus and even channels to the ground bus, and COM pairs feed WAGO taps into each valve Wye harness. Each valve MAG green wire feeds a divider and 2N7000 sense block whose output lands on DI1 or DI2.
svg.text: POWER — TAPPED FROM THE DRAINMASTER SWITCH FEED
Each CHn has three screws: NO / COM / NC.
Order drawn is assumed. Verify before wiring
Land wires on NO and COM only. NC stays empty.
